title: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Rebranded Race in Malaysia's Second City
seo_title: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Review | Johor Bahru
meta_description: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 review: September 20 at Toppen Shopping Centre, Johor Bahru -- a mall-anchored race also known as BMW Millennium Welt.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Toppen Shopping Centre, this Johor Bahru half marathon carries two names -- Tebrau City Half Marathon and BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon -- reflecting a rebrand in Malaysia's second-largest city by economic output.
verdict: The Tebrau City Half Marathon (also listed as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon) is a mall-anchored race at Toppen Shopping Centre in Johor Bahru -- Malaysia's second most economically competitive city and the country's largest state capital by population, right at the Singapore border. The dual naming suggests a rebrand or renamed continuation of a prior event, though specific history wasn't confirmed in research. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) and a registration deadline set for the day before race day keep the format straightforward, if the deadline itself is unusually tight.

sections.heading: Two Names, One Race
paragraphs: This event carries two listed names -- Tebrau City Half Marathon, powered by JomRun, and BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon -- suggesting a rebrand or renamed continuation of a prior edition. [1] Both listings point to the same 20 September 2026 date and Toppen Shopping Centre venue, so treat them as the same race under evolving branding rather than two separate events.

sections.heading: Johor Bahru: Malaysia's Southern Gateway
paragraphs: Johor Bahru is the capital of Johor state, covering 373 sq km with a 2020 population of 858,118 -- Malaysia's largest state capital by population. [2] It sits at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula bordering Singapore, ranks as Malaysia's second best-performing city economically behind only Kuala Lumpur, and hosts the world's busiest land border crossing via the Johor-Singapore Causeway. That gives race weekend genuine cross-border accessibility for Singapore-based runners.

sections.heading: Three Distances, Mall-Anchored
paragraphs: Distances offered are 21.1K, 10K and 5K, starting at Toppen Shopping Centre. [1] A mall-anchored venue means built-in parking and amenities, similar to the pattern seen at several other races in this research batch -- practical for a city with heavy cross-border weekend traffic.

sections.heading: A Tight Registration Deadline
paragraphs: Registration is open but closes 19 September 2026 -- the day before race day itself. [1] That's an unusually tight window, echoing a similar pattern seen at the KL Half Marathon (also JomRun-organised) covered elsewhere in this research, so late sign-ups shouldn't be assumed to be possible.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a well-located, mall-anchored half marathon in Malaysia's economically vibrant southern gateway city appeals -- and it's genuinely convenient for Singapore-based runners given the border crossing -- the Tebrau City Half Marathon on 20 September 2026 is a solid pick. Register early given the tight deadline, and don't be confused by the event's dual BMW Millennium Welt branding.
